script.cover_1: 10:40 pm and the phone lights up. Which text is fair?
script.payoff: The second text names tomorrow 10 am, so the night stays yours.
script.caption: A late text is not a late deadline unless it says so. Send this to the person whose phone never rests.
script.request: A manager needs an answer on a file at 10:40 pm.
script.pushy: Call me now. Why are you not picking up?
script.professional: Late text, sorry. A reply by 10 am tomorrow is fine.
script.why: It admits the late hour and gives a clear time to reply, so tonight stays free.
script.reply_me: Sorry, I was offline. I will check the file at 9 am and reply by 10 am.
